command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/*
cd /app/docs; cat lending.md exports.md loans.md fees.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app/data; cat policy.ini branches.csv calendar.csv manifest.txt exports/manifest.txt; head -5 patrons.csv waivers.csv; wc -l patrons.csv waivers.csv; cd exports; for f in har-2026-12-28.csv wst-2027-01-22.jsonl resend-cen.csv; do echo == $f; head -4 $f; done; cat /app/tools/check_fees.py | head -60

cd /app/data/exports; python3 --version; ls | grep -v -E '^(cen|wst|har|oak)-' ; for f in *.csv; do head -1 $f; done | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -o '"via": "[^"]*"' *.jsonl | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -o '"type": "[^"]*"' *.jsonl | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -o '"at": "[^"]*"' *.jsonl | sed 's/[0-9]/N/g' | sort | uniq -c; cat *.csv | grep -v '^event' | cut -d, -f2 | sed 's/[0-9]/N/g' | sort | uniq -c | head; head -c 3 cen-2026-12-15.csv | xxd | head -2; cut -d, -f1 /app/data/patrons.csv | sed 's/[0-9]/N/g' | sort | uniq -c; cut -d, -f2,3 /app/data/waivers.csv | sed 's/[0-9]/N/g'| sort | uniq -c | head -20; cut -d, -f4,5 /app/data/waivers.csv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/fees.py data out/statements.json; echo $?; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -20; python tools/check_fees.py

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/fees.py following the documented rules and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/statements.json. The unit tests pass (4 of 4) and check_fees.py matches all 228 statements and 4 branch rows."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
